# Psalm 116 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** I love the LORD because he listens to me — he hears my cries for help.

**2** Because he has turned his ear toward me, I will call on him for as long as I live.

**3** Death wrapped its ropes around me; the terrors of the grave closed in on me. I was overwhelmed by trouble and sorrow.

**4** Then I called out the LORD's name: 'LORD, please save me!'

**5** The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

**6** The LORD protects the vulnerable. When I was at the bottom, he saved me.

**7** Now I can tell my soul: 'Relax — the LORD has been so good to you.'

**8** You rescued me from death, wiped the tears from my eyes, and kept me from falling.

**9** I will live my life in the LORD's presence, right here in the land of the living.

**10** I kept believing, even when I said, 'I'm completely overwhelmed.'

**11** In my panic I blurted out, 'Nobody can be trusted!'

**12** How can I ever repay the LORD for everything he's done for me?

**13** I will raise the cup of salvation and call out the LORD's name!

**14** I will keep every promise I made to the LORD — right in front of all his people.

**15** The LORD's faithful ones are so valuable to him — their death matters deeply to him.

**16** LORD, I am truly your servant — your servant, born into your household. You have set me free!

**17** I will bring you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the LORD's name.

**18** I will keep my promises to the LORD in front of all his people,

**19** in the courtyards of the LORD's house — right in the heart of Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **116:7**: 'Relax — the LORD has been good to you.' After near-death, the psalmist talks to his own soul, telling it to settle down. Sometimes we need to remind our own hearts of what God has already done.

- **116:12-13**: 'How can I ever repay the LORD?' The answer isn't to pay him back — it's to receive more! Raise the cup of salvation. God's generosity can't be repaid; it can only be celebrated.

— PNEUMA
